failure_chain.observed_failure: Note editor dialog content textbox not found; locator.fill timed out after 10000ms
failure_chain.evidence: playwright-report-414407a79923.json; failure-details.md; REQ-2.4 design snapshot; final template db.json
failure_chain.diagnosis: REQ-2.4 design expects Project ideas to be an editable visible note, but final db.json marks Project ideas archived=true and app.js excludes archived notes from loadNotes(). The static mismatch explains why the editor may never open, but no DOM trace is available to prove the exact first failed interaction.

failure_chain.observed_failure: Work checkbox not found inside Note editor; locator.check timed out after 10000ms
failure_chain.evidence: playwright-report-414407a79923.json; failure-details.md; REQ-2.7.1 design snapshot; final app.js
failure_chain.diagnosis: The design snapshot and final app place label checkboxes in the separate Note labels dialog (#note-labels-editor), while the failing generated locator scopes them to Note editor. This is a direct test/app contract discrepancy, but suite identity is unresolved, so responsibility cannot be assigned solely to the application.

failure_chain.evidence: playwright-report-414407a79923.json; failure-details.md; REQ-2.7.2 design snapshot; final app.js
failure_chain.diagnosis: Same dialog-scope discrepancy as REQ-2.7.1: the application renders label controls through openLabelsEditor() in Note labels, while the observed test searches Note editor.

failure_chain.observed_failure: Reminders checkbox not found inside Note editor; locator.check timed out after 10000ms
failure_chain.evidence: playwright-report-414407a79923.json; failure-details.md; REQ-2.7.4 design snapshot; final app.js

failure_chain.observed_failure: Movie list remains visible after selecting Reminders; expected count 0, received 1
failure_chain.evidence: playwright-report-414407a79923.json; failure-details.md; final app.js lines 293-301 and 648-654; final db.json
failure_chain.diagnosis: The Reminders click handler sets activeLabel='Reminders', then calls showHome(); showHome() immediately resets activeLabel=null before loadNotes(). The label filter is therefore cleared and Movie list remains visible.

failure_chain.observed_failure: Pinned marker for Meeting agenda 2.8.1 not visible; title Pinned locator timed out
failure_chain.evidence: playwright-report-414407a79923.json; failure-details.md; REQ-2.8.1 design snapshot; final db.json; final app.js

Final db.json has pinned=true, so the submitted seed does not match the scenario precondition. The failure is consistent with contaminated or non-clean seed state, but no trace proves the exact click/state sequence.

failure_chain.observed_failure: Pinned marker for Meeting agenda created not visible; title Pinned locator timed out
failure_chain.evidence: playwright-report-414407a79923.json; failure-details.md; REQ-2.8.3 design snapshot; final db.json; final app.js
